method: Fresh direct semantic interpretation of each original numbered line in frozen manifest #59 lines 1–80; no V1 or machine scan credit

semantic_interpretation_segments.interpretation: JSON object opens canonical Oct17 decision collection, identifies the product, timestamp and documentation-only consolidation purpose; authority preserves 79 baseline Locked and 20 baseline Open records, then begins rules array. This is historical provenance, not current deployment/test proof.

Explicit owner supersession governs, historical implementation_status is not current completion, CURRENT_STATUS governs operations not product approval, Open questions are not auto-closed, and source order alone does not override scoped decisions. Closing brackets complete the authority object.

Dated development commit 6f37e... anchors historical source, not the current branch. Archived v1.0 ledger path, library id, version, project label and September 8 baseline date define source provenance; opening braces and separators are JSON structure, not executable behavior.

Baseline source precedence puts latest owner decision above specification/ledger, unsuperseded JSX prototype, screenshots, export fixture and previously collected research. These are evidence priorities, not a mandate to restore removed research or to overwrite later owner-approved current behavior.

First Locked decision object records the core user loop: open app, current coffee, Log Shot, rate taste, recommendation, done. Retain this behavioral invariant during #267 cleanup; syntax lines delimit the locked entry.
Locked UX complexity rule requires clean routine experience and progressive disclosure of advanced data; deleting simplification/visibility logic without callers and UX tests would violate this.
Locked initial platform is mobile-first private-beta PWA, not a native-app requirement. Offline/PWA code is not obsolete merely because a browser-first flow exists.
Locked authentication is email/password, secure persistent sessions and immutable internal user ID; current security ownership belongs to #96 and neither history nor identity guards may be removed.

Locked beta access uses revocable/replacable private signup URL while preserving existing members. Invitation-token lifecycle and data continuity require source-specific verification before modification.

Historical Locked V1 Claude-only provider with modular abstraction for future additions. Later explicit deterministic extractor/screenshot retirement supersessions are scoped; no provider migration or credential write is authorized by this archive.

Locked BYOK is optional, stored only on device and app remains usable without it. Closing JSON entry and opening next entry at line80 are accounted; later source needed to interpret next topic. Never upload a member key or turn optional BYOK into a gate.

current_counterpart.disposition: Apply later explicit scoped Locked supersessions; these baseline entries constrain current code cleanup and feature flow.
